step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture diagram shows a multi-region setup with Development in Singapore, Staging/Production in Singapore and Beijing, and a Data Lake in Tokyo.
1. Development Environment (Singapore) contains KMS, CodeBuild, and APP Servers. An arrow connects CodeBuild to KMS.
2. CodeBuild distributes deployment packages down to CloudFormation in Staging/Production Singapore and CloudFormation in Staging/Production Beijing.
3. Both Staging/Production regions contain ECR, CloudFormation, APP Servers, and RDS.
4. RDS in Singapore and RDS in Beijing connect via directed arrows into AWS Glue in the Data Lake (Tokyo) region, which also contains AWS S3.

graph.name: Ampos Multi-Region CI/CD and Centralized Data Lake Architecture
graph.notes: Shows multi-region deployment from Singapore dev environment to Singapore and Beijing staging/production environments, and data ingestion into a centralized Tokyo Data Lake.
